ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 75-80% of the surface with low-intensity (black/dark grey) margins and spots comprising the remaining 20-25%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black banding along the entire trailing edge and distal tips; scattered dark circular spots (0.5-2% area) concentrated near the tips; prominent yellowish-tan pigmentation blobs concentrated near the median notch and lower mid-sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel-derived internal angle of 78 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 4 and 12 pixels across the trailing edge; a notable deeper indentation is present on the outer-third of the left lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve sweeping upward to distal tips; visible leading edge segments exhibit a convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast dark circular pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both lobes, particularly dense on the right tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned brownish-tan linear streaks crossing the right lobe horizontally; a distinct dark vertical scratch is visible on the inner lower region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged tissue loss on the trailing edge of the left lobe; extensive yellow-brown surface staining across the lower-central region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan biofilm or pigmentation staining heavily concentrated around the median notch and extending toward the mid-lobe surfaces.
